$comment: What the WordPress end-to-end run must prove (e2e/lib/pipeline.ts, Expectations). A failed gate check in a requiredPhase fails the run unless it is listed in knownFailures as "<phase>:<checkId>" with a reason (keep the list short and dated; entries that no longer fail are reported as stale). optionalPhases run and are reported only: move load and verify to requiredPhases once they pass in CI. requiredAssertions likewise; the rendered-page assertions (html-hreflang, html-products) need load.
